description: React component for user email notification settings in Mattermost, including UI rendering and state management for email notification preferences.

classes.name: EmailNotificationSetting
classes.description: React component class for managing email notification settings in user preferences.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Synchronizes component state with incoming props, especially when re-opening the settings section.

methods.name: focusEditButton
methods.description: Sets focus on the edit button element.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles changes to email notification options, updating state and calling onChange callback.

methods.name: handleThreadsOnChange
methods.description: Handles toggling of thread notification preferences.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Saves the updated email notification preferences and updates the section state.

methods.name: handleUpdateSection
methods.description: Updates or cancels the editing section.

methods.name: renderMinSettingView
methods.description: Renders the minimized view of email notification settings.

methods.name: renderMaxSettingView
methods.description: Renders the expanded view of email notification settings, including options and descriptions.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Focuses the edit button when the section is closed and all sections are inactive.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method that switches between minimized and maximized views based on active state.
